description: Muted blue-green low-square-neck court gown with opaque fitted bodice, layered sleeves ending near the elbow, long cream underdress visible through the front skirt opening, wide decorated sash with metal clasps, paired round shoulder brooches and cream patterned wrap resting along the arms. Gold-brown geometric and curled woven borders run down the front and around the skirt; dark brown boots are visible below. Both hands rest together at the waist; full hairstyle and feet remain framed. No headgear, armor or weapon. Rich ornamentation and court tailoring incorporate the complete noble and confidence layers.
